job.job_description:
Agentic AI Engineer (Hyderabad/Chennai)
Responsibilities
Implement AI agents using predefined designs and architecture patterns
Build and test multi-step AI workflows (planner executor, tool-using agents)
Integrate LLMs with APIs, tools, and data sources
Develop prompt chains and function-calling logic
Implement basic error handling, retries, and human-in-the-loop interactions
Write clean, testable, and well-documented Python code
Participate in testing, evaluation, and improvement of agent behavior
Required Skills & Qualifications
1 3 years of experience in software development or AI projects
Strong foundation in Python programming
Understanding of REST APIs and JSON
Familiarity with LLMs (ChatGPT, Azure OpenAI, or similar)
Basic understanding of AI workflows or automation
Version control using Git
Curiosity and willingness to learn rapidly in a fast-evolving AI space
Good to have -
Exposure to LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar frameworks
Basic knowledge of prompt engineering and function calling
Experience with simple RAG pipelines
Academic, hackathon, or personal projects involving AI or automation
Understanding of basic software testing practices
